title: GHL → Inbound: bad signature rejected (401, no record)
journey: Off-camera: POST a webhook to the staging real-location endpoint with an invalid x-wh-signature (sha256=deadbeef…)
Server returns HTTP 401 'Invalid webhook signature' (code invalid_signature)
Open GHL Integration → Sync Events on staging web
Confirm a 'failed' row appears with reason 'Invalid webhook signature' (contact 'unknown') — the auth gate rejected it and created no client
